update Maven plugins, and remove junit-vintage-engine.

Based on PR #119 by @long.nguyen2306.

refactor: remove Google Guice in favor of manual wiring

Replace Guice DI framework with plain Java object construction.

- Delete all FairyModule classes and DataMasterModule (9 files)
- Add LocaleSpecificProvidersFactory with explicit factory methods per locale
- Replace javax.inject/Guice annotations with direct constructor calls
- Replace com.google.inject.Provider with java.util.function.Supplier
- Add FrAddressProvider with continental address format (fixes FR locale bug)
- Convert LocaleSpecificProviders to Java 17 record
- Remove unused constructor params from NoNationalIdentificationNumberFactory
- Net result: ~500 fewer lines of code and two fewer runtime dependencies

chore: add release workflow for tag-based publishing

Add GitHub Actions workflow triggered on v* tags that deploys to
Maven Central with GPG signing. Use flatten-maven-plugin with
${revision} property for version management.

chore: migrate from Sonatype OSSRH to Central Publishing

Replace nexus-staging-maven-plugin with central-publishing-maven-plugin.
Update distributionManagement URLs to central.sonatype.com.
fix: update maven-javadoc-plugin and disable doclint

docs: add thread safety information to README

Fixes #95
Based on PR #128 by @kdebski85.
docs: update Maven Central and Javadoc badges

feat: replace fictional Polish company names with real ones

Based on PR #129 by @mmajcherczyk. Curated list of ~200 real Polish
companies instead of 28 fictional names.

fix: ensure same passwords for same random seeds

Replace RandomStringUtils.randomAlphanumeric() with baseProducer.bothify()
for deterministic password generation based on the random seed.

Fixes #130
Based on PR #131 by @rweisleder.

fix: remove Sanford from seed data to prevent generating real emails

Fixes #146
Based on PR #147 by @joesanford.

fix: generate valid URL domain chars from IP digits

Treat IP digits as numeric values (0-9) instead of char codes when
mapping to letters, preventing illegal characters in generated URLs.

Fixes #111
Based on PR #149 by @Koziolek.

feat: add support for Brazilian locale

Add BR locale with CPF, CNPJ, Brazilian addresses, passport numbers,
and Portuguese names/cities. Uses deterministic baseProducer for
reproducible seed-based generation.

Based on PR #135 by @nelsonjunior.

feat: add support for Slovak locale

Add SK locale with rodné číslo (national ID), IČ DPH (VAT),
Slovak addresses, passport numbers, IBAN support, and Slovak names.

Based on PR #136 by @matus-cuper.

fix: SvAddressProvider now generates apartment numbers

randomInt(20) always returns >= 0, so the condition was never true.
Replace with trueOrFalse() to match AbstractAddressProvider behavior.

Fixes #132
docs: update README with installation, locales, and new features

refactor: remove Google Guava dependency

Replace all Guava usages with Java standard library equivalents:
- Preconditions.checkArgument -> if + throw IllegalArgumentException
- @VisibleForTesting -> removed (documentation-only annotation)
- Joiner/Splitter -> String.join/String.split
- Strings.isNullOrEmpty -> null check + isEmpty
- Optional (Guava) -> java.util.Optional
- Lists/Maps/Sets -> new ArrayList/HashMap/HashSet

Removes ~3MB runtime dependency with 6 transitive deps.

refactor: clean up Guava removal per code review

- Fix broken indentation in PersonProvider and PlNationalIdentityCardNumberProvider
- Use Validate.notNull/isTrue from commons-lang3 instead of hand-rolled if/throw
- Use StringUtils.isNotEmpty instead of manual null+isEmpty check
- Use Set.of() directly instead of new HashSet<>(Set.of()) for immutable set
- Use List.of() instead of Arrays.asList() for constant lists
- Remove redundant Arrays.asList wrapper around String.split result
- Fix stale comment referencing removed checkArgument
chore: pin maven-resources-plugin version for Maven 4 compatibility

chore: upgrade POM to modelVersion 4.1.0

Use Maven 4 native POM format with root="true" attribute.
Maven automatically transforms to 4.0.0 for repository publication.

refactor: remove commons-math3 and commons-text dependencies

Replace RandomDataGenerator with Java 17 Random API (nextInt/nextLong/nextDouble
with origin/bound). Replace StringEscapeUtils with TextUtils.escapeNonAscii().
Removes ~2.5MB of runtime dependencies.
chore: upgrade Spock to 2.4
docs: add unique values section to README

feat: add UniqueEnforcer and UniqueFairy for unique value generation

Add fairy.unique() returning UniqueFairy (Person by email, Company by name,
IBAN/CreditCard by number) and UniqueEnforcer.of() for custom key extraction.
Throws UniqueGenerationException after max retries (default 10,000).

Closes #9

iban(IBANProperties.Property...) overloads.

chore: set sdkmanrc to Java 17 to match project target
chore: bump sdkmanrc Java to 17.0.18-tem

refactor: centralize random string generation in RandomGenerator

Move random numeric, alphabetic, and alphanumeric logic from static
RandomUtils to instance-based RandomGenerator. This ensures all random
data generation respects the provided seed, fixing non-deterministic
behavior across locale-specific providers.

- delete RandomUtils and its tests to remove unseeded random sources
- update BaseProducer to delegate random string calls to RandomGenerator
- update locale providers (PL, EN, FR, ES) to use the seeded generator
- update Groovy Spock tests to reflect the adjusted  random sequence
  caused by consistent generator usage
- add comprehensive JUnit 5 tests for RandomGenerator

feat(locale): implement specialized French providers and improve IT locale

Introduce dedicated providers for French VAT (TVA), National Identity
Card (CNI), and Passport numbers to replace generic English fallbacks.
Improve Italian locale support by establishing its own provider factory
structure.

- add FrVATIdentificationNumberProvider with Luhn-compliant SIREN logic
- add FrNationalIdentityCardNumberProvider following biometric 2021 format
- add FrPassportNumberProvider with correct alphanumeric pattern
- refactor LocaleSpecificProvidersFactory to register new FR providers
- fix IT locale to use createItProviders (currently with EN fallbacks)
- simplify SvNationalIdentityCardNumberProvider by removing unused DateProducer
- update FairyFrSpec with new expected values and comprehensive validation
  for Luhn and format patterns

refactor: address all error-prone warnings and modernize codebase

- Upgrade error-prone to latest version
- Reconfigure compiler plugin with improved error-prone flags
- Add optional profile to fail build on error-prone findings
- Replace locale-sensitive string operations with Locale.ROOT
- Remove unused parameters and simplify method signatures
- Improve null-safety and validation (e.g. Character.digit)
- Modernize time handling with ZoneId
- Inline trivial variables and simplify logic
- Add missing @Override annotations
- Enhance Javadoc for public APIs
- Clean up formatting and minor inconsistencies

fix(build): pin error-prone to stable version to resolve CI compilation failure

Downgrade error-prone from 2.48.0 to 2.39.0 to fix a CI-only
compilation crash caused by incompatible transitive dependencies
(e.g. dataflow-errorprone) and javac internals.

The issue manifested as a ServiceLoader/ClassLoader failure during
javac plugin initialization on GitHub Actions, while builds worked
locally due to different JDK/runtime combinations

chore: bump error-prone to 2.42.0, last version supporting Java 17 (#159)

2.43.0+ requires Java 21 to run (google/error-prone#4867).

refactor: introduce de.speedbanking:iban-commons

Simplifies the IBAN generation logic by migrating from iban4j to the more
performant iban-commons library. This change streamlines the DefaultIBANProvider
by offloading random IBAN generation directly to the new library's
RandomIban utility.

Key changes:
- Switched dependency from org.iban4j:iban4j to de.speedbanking:iban-commons
- Refactored DefaultIBANProvider to use IbanRegistry and RandomIban,
  eliminating the manual Iban.Builder ceremony
- Removed several redundant fields and setters (accountNumber, bankCode,
  branchCode, nationalCheckDigit) from IBANProvider and DefaultIBANProvider,
  favoring the library's internal generation
- Simplified the IBAN data object by removing unused fields like
  identificationNumber, accountType, and ownerAccountType
- Updated IBANProperties to map LanguageCodes directly to IbanRegistry
  constants
- Updated test suite to use IbanValidator for verification

link: https://www.speedbanking.de/
